decoder.field_note: BitCount is the integer bit mask despite its name; RightShiftCount aligns the masked value.
decoder.physical_contract: physical = decoded_raw * Lsb + Offset; render with Point decimal places
decoder.raw_contract: read ByteCount bytes; decoded_raw = (raw & BitCount) >> RightShiftCount
